Turn a table, shelf or mantelpiece into a glowing Christmas feature with this illuminated ruby glass DecoBauble. Once switched on, the textured glass body lights up and gently rotates, creating an attractive pattern of moving reflections.

Its rich ruby colouring works beautifully with traditional Christmas decorations, including evergreen garlands, red and gold baubles, warm white lights and metallic accessories. MOVING LIGHT DISPLAY: The textured ruby glass body illuminates while gently rotating, creating shifting reflections that bring movement and sparkle to your Christmas tables, shelves and mantelpieces. Unlike a static ornament, the light effect continues to change as it turns, making this compact decoration a natural focal point.
FLEXIBLE CORDLESS DISPLAY: Battery power lets you position the DecoBauble away from plug sockets and without trailing wires. Use it on a dining table, sideboard, fireplace or shelf, either as a stand-alone feature or alongside garlands, baubles, candles and warm white lights.
AUTOMATIC FESTIVE GLOW: Features a built-in auto time. The ruby colouring and metallic top complement both traditional and contemporary Christmas schemes. The decorative glass finish also looks attractive during daylight when the light is switched off.
DETAILS: Supplied as one indoor InLit Spinning DecoBauble in Ruby. Insert 3 x AAA batteries, which are not included, position it upright on a stable surface and activate the light and timer according to the enclosed instructions.
ABOUT US: At YouGarden, we believe that gardening is for everyone. Based in rural Lincolnshire, we have our own 11-acre nursery, meaning that we are in close contact with our plants, so that we can guarantee our plants will thrive because we've nurtured them ourselves.

5056797098985.variantName: MySmartBuy Acrylic LED Bear, 40 White LED Outdoor Christmas Decoration
5056797098985.sourceDescription:
Add a cuddly festive character to your display with this acrylic light up bear from MySmartBuy. 40 bright white LEDs give the clear acrylic a crisp, frosty glow. Ideal for gardens, porches, pathways and entrances, and just as lovely in an indoor festive display. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable and BS IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Light up figures are one of the easiest ways to make your home stand out at Christmas. Group several together to tell a festive story on the lawn, use them to frame the front door or path, or place one where it can be seen from the window so the whole family can enjoy it from inside too. Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. At a glance: acrylic bear | 40 bright white LEDs | 5m lead cable | BS IP20 transformer | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | indoor and outdoor use.
ACRYLIC LIGHT UP BEAR : 40 bright white LEDs for a crisp, frosty seasonal glow.
CHARMING FESTIVE CHARACTER : A sweet alternative to traditional reindeer and snowmen.
5M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 5m lead cable and BS IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
AUTOMATIC TIMER : Built-in 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer, so it lights up at the same time every evening without you having to remember.
INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE : Gardens, porches, pathways, entrances and indoor displays.
